subject: krea2-raw-transformer-nsfw is half-migrated: noMirror dropped, mirrorUrl not added - UNRELEASED.md:460 now overclaims
body:
FINDING - the dep entry is half-migrated, and it changes what a release note claims.

Measured just now by importing modelDeps.js + assetDeps.js + loraDeps.js in bare node:
  noMirror:true count = 3  -> taesdxl-decoder, taef1-decoder, taef2-decoder
  krea2-raw-transformer-nsfw: noMirror = undefined, mirrorUrl = undefined

So step 'drop noMirror' has landed and step 'add mirrorUrl' has not. The dep is
single-route in reality while no longer being DECLARED single-route.

WHY IT MATTERS TO THE CUT. docs/releases/UNRELEASED.md:460 reads 'Three files still
have a single route - the three small preview decoders, which exist nowhere else in
the form the app needs.' That sentence is true against the noMirror flag (3) and
false against reality: a 12.25GB model (lustify-v10-krea-raw-int8_convrot,
13148974712 bytes) has exactly one route and is not named. A user on a network that
blocks models.cubric.studio gets no fallback for it and the notes imply they would.

TWO ACCEPTABLE ENDS, both cheap:
  1. Upload completes -> add mirrorUrl to the dep. Note and reality then agree,
     nothing else to change.
  2. Upload cannot complete -> restore noMirror:true and reword :460 back to four
     ('three small preview decoders and one large model'). MPI-433's own brief
     already anticipates this wording.
NOT acceptable: leaving it as it stands, which is a claimed fallback that does not
exist.

TIMING. I hold MPI-450, the 1.4 release umbrella. The notes freeze at
/mpi-version-bump to 1.4.0, which is gated behind a full smoke matrix now running
(~1h). I will not freeze the notes until this resolves, so there is time - but this
is the last gate that touches your dep.

OWNERSHIP. I am NOT editing js/data/modelConstants/modelDeps.js - that block is
yours. I am not editing UNRELEASED.md:460 either until you say which end applies.
Reply with 1 or 2 and I will take the UNRELEASED.md half if you want it off your
plate.

FYI unrelated to your card, same file family: UNRELEASED.md:176 says the new video
previews need 'nothing extra to download'. taeh3-decoder (21.66MB) and
ltx23-preview-taehv (22.44MB) are model deps, not engine assets, so an existing
H3/LTX owner does pull ~22MB on update. That one is mine to fix, not yours.

recent_events.note: Premise disproven at runtime: the dep has 2 routes via the generic prefix rewrite; no mirrorUrl field is by design. UNRELEASED.md:460 stands.
